summary: ALTR's one visible fix this week backfired. On 10/11 Mayson relaunched her link-in-bio domain, barbarasilva.vip, describing it as 'completely safe' and saying it 'won’t get flagged'. The team added it to the backup account they are logged into. Within about 21 hours that account went down ('hey so my account went down, and this link was just added'). It is most likely @barbarasilvanew, the account handed to the VA team on 10/1. Mayson's first reply asked her to remove the link herself, although she pointed out 'I didn’t add it in, I think the team is logged in'. Her bio was also gone. On 10/15 Mayson told her 'We've taken the domain down' and switched her to a direct xli.ink link. He gave no word on the downed account, no explanation, and no recovery plan. This is the second time a team-side profile change preceded a ban, against Derrek's own 9/20 warning ('Any changes like that normally bring the account right back down'), and she still has no written hygiene list. The main @thebrazilianfitbarbie is 'still in limbo' (her words, 10/11): 29 days banned with no date. Her 9/14 retention message ('where the numbers are right now isn’t sustainable for me') is now 32 days without a written answer. Invoice #6 (Oct 1–14, the second consecutive fortnight with the main banned) went out 10/15 before it was answered. Billing did improve: a two-day heads-up (10/13), sent on cadence, no pause-of-work line, no chasers. The leak report landed a third consecutive week (10/9). (2) Long-promised deliverables have no written proof: main recovery, the hygiene list (84 days), OFTV (53 days), Michelle's backup @ (76 days), and her 10/5 @itsbarbxoxo and Threads questions (11 days). The one thing delivered, the domain, was pulled four days later. (3) Owner silence: Derrek's last message in this chat was 10/1, 15 days ago. That is not yet 30, but it reaches 30 on 10/31. Not present: billing is 3 of 18 ALTR messages. Her asks rebounded from 2 to 5, but every one was a reaction to ALTR's link change. She raised nothing about growth, OFTV or the main, and she has been silent since 10/12 22:55 through invoice #6 and the 10/15 link switch.
